description: Design-level SMDL modules for the OpenSign CoolLED stack. Each module owns one layer of the architecture and declares what it owns vs delegates in its Semantics block, so work can be split cleanly. Complements seedscript/manifest.json (the runtime package pack).
layers: hardware_probe  -> observe the sign, draft a profile
protocol/codec  -> encode commands + emit pacing hints
protocol/transport -> move bytes, honor pacing, gate execute
animation       -> render scenes to transport-neutral frames
sdk/api         -> orchestrate panels, execute gate, tracing

modules.summary: Scan for the transient power-on name, decode advertisement geometry, enumerate GATT, draft a cited profile. Never writes.

modules.status: governance; brightness + static image (0x03) verified; stored_animation (0x04) + native_text_scroll (0x02) experimental; streaming rejected; codec selection gated on allow_experimental (runtime admits experimental for live delivery, execute alone gates writes)
modules.summary: Evidence-first profile lifecycle (unverified -> experimental -> verified | rejected), capped confidence, per-mode frame_transfer governance (static vs animation), palette derivation from color_mode (plus the measured flicker-fusion ceiling as a device fact and the perceived temporal-FRC gamut), and the status gate codec selection enforces.

modules.status: hardware-verified (brightness 0x08, image 0x03, animation 0x04 -- 0x04 confirmed 2026-07-13, 30 KiB / 80-frame buffer; native text scroll 0x02 + mode 0x06 + speed 0x07 confirmed 2026-07-14, higher speed byte = faster)
modules.summary: Wire framing, control opcodes, bitplane packing, 128-byte checksummed chunks, native text-scroll banner (0x02 wide bitmap + 81-byte header, motion via mode 0x06 / speed 0x07), animation preflight (frame/payload budget + single global speed), an ack decoder, and the await-ack flow_control hint. Owns encoding, not writes.

Device-agnostic BLE delivery: chunk sizing, dry-run plan vs writes, race-safe per-packet ack handshake with a codec-supplied ack decoder and NAK re-send, host-success vs ack telemetry, per-panel serialization + transfer deadline, execute gating.

modules.status: compile-only; static render hardware-verified (HELLO, COOL); animation compile confirmed 2026-07-13 (80-frame 64x16 GIF); temporal-colour (FRC) stills confirmed against the ~62 Hz fusion ceiling
modules.summary: Scene, animated source, or a still expanded into a temporal (frame-rate-control) subframe loop -> RGB888 -> fit/orient -> levels -> timeline resample -> palette quantize (or temporal dither) -> hashed bundle. Compile-only: hands off at the bundle boundary; no encoding, no delivery, no BLE.

Sole cross-module orchestrator: panel registry, global execute gate + per-call override, bounded animated-media ingest, temporal-colour image option, three-truths recording (host/ack/display), tracing, artifacts, and the FastAPI endpoints (/status, /text, /image [static|temporal], /animation, /bundle, /brightness, /power).

data_flow: Hardware evidence -> DeviceProfileLedger (governed profile + palette from color_mode)
Scene, animated source, or temporal-FRC still + palette + fusion ceiling -> PixelFramePipeline (quantized or duty-cycle-dithered, hashed RGB888 bundle)
Profile + bundle -> CoolLEDXProtocol (preflight + framed packets + flow_control/ack decoder)
Packets + flow_control -> GuardedTransport (guarded, ack-paced BLE writes with NAK re-send)
SignControlService -> the sole orchestrator: compile -> encode -> deliver, with an execute gate and traces

workstreams.title: Ack semantics: decode NAK and retry
workstreams.outcome: Implemented and unit-tested: the codec supplies an ack decoder (decode_coolledx_ack) and the transport distinguishes success (0x00) from checksum error (0x06), re-sending a NAKed packet (naks / nak_retries on TransferResult) instead of treating any notification as success. Remaining: exercise the 0x06 NAK path on real hardware (only 0x00 success acks observed so far).

workstreams.title: Profile schema + promotion tooling
workstreams.outcome: A JSON Schema for CI validation and a promotion helper that enforces evidence-before-status transitions instead of hand-editing JSON.

workstreams.title: Closed-loop display verification
workstreams.outcome: Wire observed display confirmation (camera/light sensor) into SignControlService's three-truths recording and surface it, plus ack telemetry (acks_received / naks / ack_timeouts / nak_retries), in /status and traces.

workstreams.title: Animation + scheduling
workstreams.outcome: Compile pipeline (bounded decode / timeline resample / ordered dither / preflight) and a bounded /play_animation entry are implemented (PixelAnimationStudio.create_gif_bundle + OpenSignRuntime.play_animation_base64 + the API /animation route), and as of 2026-07-13 animation displays on hardware (0x04) with the 30 KiB / 80-frame buffer enforced and dither=none paired with NEAREST; remaining: unify the compiler under the create_animation_bundle name, confirm multi-frame cadence/timing on hardware, and drive scheduler playlists.

workstreams.title: API hardening + multi-panel
workstreams.outcome: Auth/rate-limiting before non-local exposure, reconnect policy exercised, and one request fanning out to many signs.

workstreams.title: Temporal colour (frame-rate control)
workstreams.outcome: A still expands into N binarized subframes (spatiotemporal ordered dither) played on 0x04 above the measured ~62 Hz fusion ceiling so per-pixel duty cycle reads as intermediate colour; levels (black/white point) tame dark sources. Implemented (render.temporal_dither_frames/apply_levels, studio.create_temporal_image_bundle, coolled image --temporal/--black-level/--white-level, scripts/flicker_probe.py, tests); remaining: per-channel perceptual calibration and a target-RGB -> per-channel-duty gamut map, plus recording hardware.flicker_fusion_hz in the profile.

shared_invariants: No physical BLE write occurs unless execute=true; otherwise a byte-exact dry-run plan is produced. The flag's default is set at the entry point: the one-shot CLIs (coolled text/image/gif, opensign-send) default execute=true and take --dry-run to opt out, while the long-running API server stays render-only until armed.
A claim never advances status without appended evidence citing a source; verified requires live-hardware evidence.

Codec selection is gated on allow_experimental, not on write-vs-plan: verified-only when false (the opt-in strict gate, which also requires replay_safe), verified+experimental when true; the runtime selects with allow_experimental=true for both dry-run and live delivery so a controlled live test can promote experimental toward verified.
Host write success, per-chunk ack telemetry, and observed display confirmation are three separate truths.
Rendering is transport-neutral; only the device codec knows the wire format; only the transport touches the radio.
PixelFramePipeline compiles bundles only; SignControlService is the sole cross-module orchestrator (compile -> encode -> deliver).
The display palette is derived from the profile color_mode by DeviceProfileLedger and handed to the renderer; device colour knowledge never leaks into compilation.

static_image (0x03) and stored_animation (0x04) are independent claims; animation is preflighted against the measured 30 KiB device frame buffer (80 frames at 64x16) plus the structural caps (frame_count <= 255; 16-bit payload) and rejected rather than truncated.

The native single-frame palette and the temporal-FRC perceived gamut are distinct: temporal dithering time-averages native colours into a larger but luminance-limited perceived volume, never a new single-frame colour.

The flicker-fusion ceiling is a measured, evidence-backed device fact; a temporal (FRC) loop must be timed above it (N * speed_ms <= 1000 / fusion_hz) or it reads as visible flicker instead of a fused tone.
